headline: Initial F1 India Agreement Signed
factual_description: IOA and FOM sign provisional agreement to bring Formula 1 Grand Prix racing to India.

headline: Race Promotion Agreement (RPA) Executed
factual_description: Jaypee Sports International (JPSI) signs 5-year RPA with FOWC committing ~ annual hosting fees with 5% escalation.

headline: Construction of Buddh International Circuit
factual_description: Jaypee Group initiates private construction of 5.125 km Hermann Tilke-designed BIC in Greater Noida at ~ cost.

headline: Sports Ministry Classifies F1 as Entertainment
factual_description: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports refuses to categorize F1 as a recognized sport, disqualifying it from sports import exemptions.

headline: Customs Duty & ATA Carnet Bonding Friction
factual_description: Central Board of Excise and Customs requires substantial security deposits/bank guarantees for team equipment transit.

headline: UP Entertainment Tax Dispute & Escrow Order
factual_description: Allahabad High Court orders JPSI to deposit 25% of ticket sales in escrow following denial of entertainment tax exemption.

headline: Inaugural Indian Grand Prix Held
factual_description: Buddh International Circuit hosts first F1 race with ~95,000 race day spectators (~110,000 weekend); won by Sebastian Vettel.

headline: Second Indian Grand Prix Attendance Drops
factual_description: Race-day attendance declines by 31.6% to ~65,000 spectators as novelty wears off; won by Sebastian Vettel.

headline: Jaypee Group Debt & Currency Depreciation
factual_description: Macroeconomic headwinds cause INR to slide from 46.7 to over 58.6/USD, increasing effective INR burden of USD-denominated hosting fees.

headline: Announcement of 2014 Calendar Hiatus
factual_description: FOM announces Indian GP will not be held in 2014 due to scheduling and bureaucratic friction, with planned return in 2015.

headline: Third and Final Indian Grand Prix
factual_description: Attendance records ~60,000 race-day spectators; Sebastian Vettel wins race and clinches 4th Drivers World Championship.

headline: Permanent Omission from F1 Calendar
factual_description: FIA and FOM release 2014/2015 schedules confirming Indian GP has been permanently omitted due to unresolved commercial terms.

headline: Delhi High Court Permanent Establishment Ruling
factual_description: Delhi High Court holds BIC served as a Permanent Establishment (PE) for FOWC, creating Indian tax liability on fee transfers.

headline: Supreme Court Landmark Judgment on FOWC PE
factual_description: Supreme Court affirms BIC was a fixed place PE for FOWC under Art 5(1) DTAA; rules business profits and royalty income taxable in India.

headline: YEIDA Seals Buddh International Circuit
factual_description: YEIDA seals circuit following prolonged default by Jaypee Infratech / JPSI on thousands of crores in land lease dues.
